newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: IMF renews links with Madagascar with $70 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: IMF renews links with Madagascar with $70 mln loan.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has agreed to give Madagascar an Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility loan of $70 million, a Madagascan diplomatic source in Washington said on Thursday.
The loan signals that Madagascar is back in favour with the IMF and World Bank after a break of five years.

A first tranche of $13.6 million should be unblocked within the next two weeks. There will then be further tranches of $27.1 million in 1997, another $27.1 million in 1998 and $13.6 million in 1999, the source added.
A World Bank loan is expected to follow early in 1997.

Monetary sources in Madagascar said that the agreement with the IMF should lend support to the Madagascan franc, which has been weak for some time. It was quoted at 4,000 per U.S. dollar on November 25.
